title: SIDESTORY: SO LONG, ADELE: HOME AWAY FROM HOME RERUN
lines: 01 SIDESTORY: SO LONG, ADELE: HOME AWAY FROM HOME RERUN
DURATION: January 3, 2025, 10:00 - January 17, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10

DETAILS: So Long, Adele: Home Away From Home event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, participating in Siestan Fashion Street, completing the event missions, and redeeming from Event Store.
EVENT STAGE DURATION:
[A Holiday at the Hot Springs]
Duration: January 3, 2025, 10:00 - January 13, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[Treasurehunting in Siesta]
Duration: January 3, 2025, 10:00 - January 13, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[Surfing the Lava]
Duration: January 3, 2025, 10:00 - January 13, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[Siestan Fashion Street]
DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain rewards by purchasing and selling goods in "Siestan Fashion Street".
REWARDS: Mountaincomm Trade Supplies (provides random materials), Trip to the 'White Volcano' Furniture (Pieces), Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, etc.
[Dolly's Task List]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Dolly's Task List] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
REWARDS: [★★★★★: Bryophyta], Trip to the 'White Volcano' Furniture (Pieces), Fluffy Critter Wool, Module Materials, etc.
['White Volcano']
DURATION: January 3, 2025, 10:00 - January 17, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain Fluffy Critter Wool. Fluffy Critter Wool can be used to redeem items in ['White Volcano'].
REWARDS: Bryophyta's token, Trip to the 'White Volcano' Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, etc.
NOTE:

The requirements to obtain certain medals for this event have been updated. Players who have participated in the original event and met the adjusted requirements will receive the corresponding medals once logged in.
Once the rerun ends, the Medal Set of this event can no longer be obtained via any method, including the [Side Story].
This event rerun will carry on the stage progress and First Clear progress.

The once-only rewards in the rerun will automatically be converted to Intelligence Certificates for players who have already claimed them. Please refer to [Intelligence Certificate Conversion Rules] for more details.
[Intelligence Certificate Area] will be restocked as the event rerun begins. In addition, new redeemable will be added.
Operators Eyjafjalla the Hvít Aska, Swire the Elegant Wit, Poncirus, and Bryophyta will gain more trust during the event rerun.
After the event rerun ends, the event stages will be available in [Side Story] from January 17, 2025, 04:00 (UTC-7).
